description: This PHP source file defines the DatabaseStore class, which implements the Store interface for persisting monitoring data into a database within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for flushing monitor metrics to the database, constructing SQL insert statements, and handling different data types.

classes.name: DatabaseStore
classes.description: Implements the Store interface to save monitoring metrics into a database, with a focus on constructing and executing SQL insert statements based on monitor data.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Collects metrics from a monitor object, constructs an SQL INSERT statement with appropriate data type conversions, and executes the query to store the data in the database.
